content: To the best of our knowledge, most studies on adversarial example generation in NLP have largely ignored these additional criteria BIBREF2, BIBREF3, BIBREF4, BIBREF5. We believe the lack of a rigorous evaluation framework partially explains why adversarial training for NLP models has not seen the same extent of improvement compared to CV models. As our experiments reveal, examples generated from most attacking methods are successful in fooling the classifier, but their language is often unnatural and the original label is not properly preserved.
